notes: I Am Going! is from Mo Willems' Elephant and Piggie series. The story centres on Piggie announcing she is leaving for lunch, causing Gerald (the elephant) to become distraught. Key emotional vocabulary (sad, cry, alone) is central to the humour and meaning of the book. Both Gerald and Piggie are named distinctive characters and will need sourced clip art rather than generic Boardmaker symbols. 'Come back' is treated as a two-word phrase critical to Gerald's repeated pleading and should appear as a single cell if the board software allows compound labels.
